caption: The drawing depicts a single garment, specifically a long-sleeved, cropped jacket or blouse rendered in vibrant shades of blue. The jacket has a fitted waist and long, full sleeves that taper toward the wrists. The neckline is round and simple, with no collar, and the front appears plain, lacking visible buttons or fasteners. The jacket is presented flat against a plain, light beige or off-white background, which lacks any additional objects or decorative elements. The blue color of the jacket varies in intensity, indicating folds, creases, and shadows, giving the fabric a textured and slightly glossy appearance. The edges of the garment are clean and clearly defined.
title: Silk Waist
